task_type.description: underlying_problem: Finds the underlying problem behind a planned solution, before it is built.; ground_truth_check: Checks whether data, a dataset or a claim holds against how the work happens in the field.; ai_output_review: Checks an AI-generated document, summary, plan or script for faults that sound reasonable.

question.description: What the principal wants to know, in one or two sentences.

artefact_urls.description: Links to the data, document, output or brief to look at.

artefact_text.description: The material itself, when it is not at a link.

context.description: Who it is for, who decided it, where it is used.

agent.description: Name of the agent sending on the principal's behalf, if any.

deadline.description: At least 7 days after the payment.

public_backlog_ok.description: true: task_type, status and dates may appear on the public backlog. The content never does.

payment_txid.description: On-chain txid, or the Lightning payment hash once the Lightning rail is live.

external_check_ok.description: true: an external model may check the draft answer, so the request text leaves his machines. Default false: local only.

payment_proof_bip322.description: Optional. BIP-322 signature over the SHA-256 of this request body, by a key that spent an input of the payment.

completion_reward_sats.description: Optional proposal; the reward is agreed in the tier 2 reply.
